interpretation_for_paper: Major 2025 upper-tail stress regime. Contains the largest price event and concentrated £250+/£300+ activity.
Broad elevated-price regime after January, with meaningful £100+/£150+ stress but limited extreme spike realization.
Transition into surplus/downward-price conditions, with increasing negative-price exposure and weak spike activity.
Mixed-tail regime combining negative-price exposure with renewed upper-tail spike activity.
Summer surplus-heavy regime, characterised by negative-price frequency and limited extreme spike activity.
Autumn transition regime with mixed-tail behaviour and renewed £250+/£300+ stress.
Quiet late-year regime with limited spike activity and comparatively softer upper-tail conditions.
